newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Oct wage settlements average 2.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada Oct wage settlements average 2.7 pct.

text.p: Annual wage increases in Canadian collective bargaining agreements reached in October averaged 2.7 percent, up from 1.6 percent in September, the Department of Human Resources Development said on Wednesday
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast a 1.4 percent increase in wage settlements in October.

Wage increases are the average annual percentage increase in base rates -- the wage rate of the lowest paid classification in a bargaining unit -- over the term of the agreement in settlements negotiated during the period shown.
(For more information on the settlements, contact Human Resources Development's Workplace Information Directorate, at 1-800-567-6866 or 819-997-3117.)
